info.name: Lead Finder API
info.description:
All 54 API endpoints of lead-finder-next.

1. Set `baseUrl`, `email`, `password` (and `adminEmail`/`adminPassword`) in the collection Variables tab.
2. Run **Auth → Login** first. Postman keeps the `lf_session` cookie for localhost automatically.
3. For Admin requests, run **Auth → Login (admin)** first.

WARNING: requests marked ⚠️ delete or replace real data. Use them on a test database only.
